2607.07232.title: DiPhon: Diffusion on Graphons for Scalable Graph Generation
2607.07232.paper_summary: Diffusion models represent a leading paradigm for graph generation, with notable impact in domains such as molecular design. Yet, scaling these models to large graphs remains an open problem. We approach this question in the dense-graph setting through the lens of graphons, the size-agnostic limit objects of dense graph sequences, to study how structural graph statistics behave across node-size scales. This perspective leads to DiPhon, a diffusion framework for size-scalable graph generation. Specifically, we formulate a continuous diffusion process on the graphon space via a Jacobi stochastic differential equation (SDE), and propose DiPhon, a discretized graph-level process that mimics these dynamics on finite graphs. We further derive the corresponding reverse-time process, which requires access to the marginal score. For the Jacobi process, this score interestingly admits a tractable form, which we estimate from data via graph denoising and plug into the reverse process to generate graph samples. We prove that DiPhon matches exactly the first moment of the marginal distributions induced by the continuous graphon process, and approximates the second moment up to a closed-form discrepancy. Thus, DiPhon inherits key size-agnostic statistical properties of the graphon dynamics, providing a principled route toward scalable graph generation. Empirically, we demonstrate this scalability by training on small graphs and generating progressively larger graphs at inference time, without retraining, while preserving their core topological properties.
2607.07232.paper_summary_zh: 擴散模型代表了圖形生成的主要範式，在分子設計等領域具有顯著影響。然而，將這些模型擴展到大圖仍然是一個未解決的問題。我們通過圖形的密集圖設定，從圖形的視角出發，研究結構圖形統計在節點大小尺度上的行為。這一視角導致了DiPhon，一個用於大小可擴展圖形生成的擴散框架。具體而言，我們通過雅可比隨機微分方程（SDE）在圖形空間上形成一個連續擴散過程，並提出DiPhon，一個離散的圖級過程，模擬這些在有限圖形上的動態。我們進一步推導出相應的反向時間過程，這需要訪問邊際分數。對於雅可比過程，這個分數有趣地承認了一種可處理的形式，我們通過圖形去噪從數據中估計它，並將其插入反向過程以生成圖形樣本。我們證明DiPhon完全匹配由連續圖形過程引起的邊際分佈的第一矩，並近似第二矩，直到一個封閉形式的差異。因此，DiPhon繼承了圖形動態的關鍵大小無關統計特性，為可擴展圖形生成提供了一條原則性的途徑。在實證上，我們通過在小圖上訓練並在推理時生成逐漸增大的圖，而不需要重新訓練，同時保留其核心拓撲特性，來展示這種可擴展性。
